page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.large is an entry-level compute-optimized server instance built on x86_64 architecture. Powered by a single physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, it provides 2 dedicated virtual CPUs across two threads per core. The system is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM allocation ratio characteristic of compute-focused hardware profiles. The processor features 35 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AES-NI. Network connectivity is provisioned with a 1 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Local storage is omitted from this instance profile, necessitating external block storage volumes, and no GPU accelerators are present.

Performance benchmark results place this instance within an entry-level compute tier. Under synthetic processor testing, the instance scores 1305.19 in single-core and 1737.28 in multi-core stress-ng tests. Geekbench evaluations yield a single-core score of 1156.0 and a multi-core score of 1379.0, with software compilation using Clang reaching a score of 1734.0. Uncached large-block memory read speed reaches 12.97 GB/sec, while write bandwidth measures 11.91 GB/sec. In application-level benchmarks, the server delivers 1.7 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and achieves a static web serving throughput of 2.0 GB/sec.

With its single physical core setup and baseline networking throughput, ecs.c6e.large represents a cost-effective choice for small workload requirements where guaranteed dedicated vCPU resources are needed without shared-core CPU credit limits. The combination of modest RAM capacity and absence of local NVMe drives restricts its suitability for memory-dense databases or intensive parallel processing. It is best aligned with lightweight microservices, basic web servers, simple CI/CD build tasks, and low-concurrency backend utilities.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.large is a compute-optimized virtual server instance featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by a single physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz with 4.0 GB of RAM. Operating on KVM hypervisor technology and x86_64 architecture, it integrates 35 MB of L3 cache and supports instruction sets including AVX-512 and AES-NI. The instance lacks bundled local NVMe storage and GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached volumes and offering a 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations indicate entry-level compute capabilities, recording a PassMark CPU score of 2138.85, a Geekbench multi-core score of 1379.0, and 1.7 million Redis SET operations per second. Memory bandwidth uncached reads reach 12.97 GB/sec. With its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, ecs.c6e.large provides an economical resource profile tailored for lightweight microservices, basic web serving, light CI/CD workers, and low-concurrency backend tasks.
